note: Android screens with no counterpart in the iOS probe baseline. They have no page contract (there is nothing to extract), so this file is their explicit registration; a screen that is neither here nor in a contract is an `unmapped-android-screen` failure. Each entry names the evidence that the baseline really lacks the page.

screens.reason: The baseline has no `struct SessionHistoryPage`: history is the ChatPage's `⋯` → 历史 entry in README §1, which the probe app never implemented as its own page. Android implemented it as a full screen, so there is no iOS structure to mirror.
screens.evidence: grep -rn 'struct SessionHistoryPage' examples/probe-app → no match (README §1 lists it as `later`)
